services.title: Allergy & Sinusitis
services.short: Allergic rhinitis, dust and seasonal allergies, sinusitis and recurring colds.
services.intro: The complaint patients mention most often in their reviews of this clinic. Allergic rhinitis, dust allergies, sinusitis and the blocked-nose-every-morning pattern are treated by looking for what sets your reaction off, not by suppressing it each time it flares.
services.note: Bring any allergy test reports and your current inhalers or antihistamines to the first consultation so treatment can be coordinated safely.

services.title: Pediatric Care & Adenoids
services.short: Adenoid enlargement, snoring, mouth-breathing, recurrent colds and tonsillitis in children.
services.intro: Parents come to this clinic most often for enlarged adenoids — a child snoring through the night, breathing through the mouth, sleeping badly and struggling to concentrate at school, with surgery already on the table. Treatment is gentle, reviewed at every visit, and coordinated with your ENT specialist.
services.note: Never stop or postpone a surgery your specialist has advised without discussing it with them first. Bring the scan or scope report to your consultation.

services.title: Migraine & Headaches
services.short: Migraine, tension headaches and the triggers behind the pattern.
services.intro: Headache care here begins with the pattern — when attacks come, what sets them off, how they end, what else changes around them. Remedies are chosen individually against that picture and reviewed over follow-ups rather than swapped at every visit.
services.note: A simple headache diary for two weeks before your visit — timing, triggers, duration — makes the first consultation considerably more useful.

services.title: Skin & Hair
services.short: Eczema, psoriasis, acne, urticaria, fungal complaints and hair fall.
services.intro: Skin complaints rarely sit on the skin alone. Treatment considers triggers, stress, digestion and history together, which is why the consultation asks about far more than the rash in front of us.
services.note: Photographs of a flare at its worst help, since skin often looks calmer on the day of the appointment than it does at 2am.

services.title: General & Lifestyle
services.short: Digestive complaints, thyroid and hormonal concerns, joint pain and weight.
services.intro: Long-standing complaints that have been managed rather than resolved — acidity, IBS, thyroid and hormonal concerns, joint pain, weight — are treated constitutionally, alongside whatever your physician already has you on.
services.note: Bring recent lab work. Homoeopathic treatment runs alongside your existing prescriptions — never in place of them without your physician's involvement.

faqs.q: How long does homoeopathic treatment take to work?
faqs.a: It depends on the complaint and how long you have had it. Acute problems often respond quickly; long-standing conditions are treated over several weeks with regular review. Your doctor will set realistic expectations at the first consultation rather than promise a timeline.

faqs.q: Can my child avoid adenoid surgery with homoeopathy?
faqs.a: Many parents come here hoping to, and reviews describe children improving considerably. But that is not a guarantee, and it is not a decision to make alone — keep your ENT specialist involved, bring the scan reports, and never postpone advised surgery without discussing it with them.

faqs.q: Can I take homoeopathic medicines with my existing prescriptions?
faqs.a: In most cases yes. Never stop or reduce a prescribed medication on your own — bring your current prescriptions to the consultation so treatment can be planned around them.
Walk-ins are seen during consulting hours, but a WhatsApp message or a call ahead means far less waiting, especially in the evening session.

faqs.q: Is there a special diet during treatment?
faqs.a: No strict diet is needed. You may be asked to avoid strong flavours such as raw onion, garlic or coffee immediately before and after taking a remedy.

faqs.q: Where exactly is the clinic and is there parking?
faqs.a: Kappalandimukku, Kochi — near the Bharat Petroleum pump, about ten minutes from Fort Kochi. There is free parking, and the consulting rooms are on the ground floor.
